expectations.text: Recommends co-locating a type with the module that owns it as the default (not a central types.ts)
expectations.evidence: 'a type should live next to the code that owns it... A type used by exactly one module belongs in that module's file, not in types.ts.'

expectations.text: Reframes 'single source of truth' as defined-once, not all-in-one-file
expectations.evidence: 'Single source of truth is the right instinct; "single file" is the part to drop.'

expectations.text: Keeps genuinely shared/global types in a shared or feature-level file (does NOT advise one-type-per-file scattering)
expectations.evidence: Feature-local types file + small global file for primitives; 'Don't shatter it into one-type-per-file — that swings too far the other way.'

expectations.text: Grounds it in the agent skipping the cross-file lookup (the central types file is the sibling it won't open)
expectations.evidence: 'The agent is reluctant to go look at adjacent files... that's a cross-file lookup the agent often won't make — so it works from a partial picture.'
